def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # flipper_length_mm: text numbers -> numeric and fix negatives (data entry sign error)
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
    df.loc[df['flipper_length_mm'] < 0, 'flipper_length_mm'] = df.loc[df['flipper_length_mm'] < 0, 'flipper_length_mm'].abs()
    # optional: enforce allowed range 170-235 -> NaN if still out of range
    # df.loc[(df['flipper_length_mm'] < 170) | (df['flipper_length_mm'] > 235), 'flipper_length_mm'] = pd.NA
    # body_mass_g: text numbers and out_of_range 2500-6500 (not needed for question but cleaned)
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'], errors='coerce')
    df.loc[(df['body_mass_g'] < 2500) | (df['body_mass_g'] > 6500), 'body_mass_g'] = pd.NA
    # sex: label variant FEMALE vs female -> lower case, strip
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].astype('object').apply(lambda x: x.strip().lower() if isinstance(x, str) else x)
    return df

def answer(df):
    # ensure flipper_length_mm is numeric and negatives fixed even if clean not called
    d = df.copy()
    d['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(d['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
    d.loc[d['flipper_length_mm'] < 0, 'flipper_length_mm'] = d.loc[d['flipper_length_mm'] < 0, 'flipper_length_mm'].abs()
    d = d.dropna(subset=['species'])
    grouped = d.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()
    return {str(k): float(v) for k, v in grouped.items() if pd.notna(k)}
